sv.title: ”Ring gamlingen igen” – så avslöjades åldringsbedragarna
sv.summary: Minuter efter att den äldre kvinnan lurats att swisha 15 000 kronor köptes en orange Iphone för hennes pengar. Bedrägerisamtalet fångades av polisens avlyssning. En månad senare kastades samma telefon från en balkong i Spanien i samma stund polisen slog till.

en.title: "Call the old man again" – how the elderly fraudsters were exposed
en.summary: Minutes after the elderly woman was tricked into Swishing SEK 15,000, an orange iPhone was bought with her money. The fraud call was captured by police wiretapping. A month later, the same phone was thrown from a balcony in Spain at the same moment police made their arrest.
